verdict.rationale: Working Copy has no documented native scheduler for recurring jobs. It does offer change-triggered Auto-Sync, which commits, pulls and pushes when changes are detected, and Background Sync keeps this running while you use other apps. It also integrates with the Shortcuts app for automation, which could serve as an external trigger, but the evidence never says time-based scheduling works through it. Missing for 10: native time-based or cron-style scheduling, documented recurring workflow triggers via Shortcuts, scheduling of Repository Agent tasks, independent corroboration.
